previous_statement: The functional phi is 1-Lipschitz for the l1 metric, and the row-geometry part of def-signed-idempotent gives ||p_v-p_j||_1<=D:=2+4*delta for all rows. Therefore t_j:=H-phi(p_j)=phi(p_v)-phi(p_j) satisfies t_j<=D; the preceding distance comparison gives t_j>=0 for all j and t_j>=H-a*tau for j notin G_a.
new_statement: The functional phi(x)=u.x+b has ||u||_inf<=1, hence is 1-Lipschitz for the l1 metric. By the row-geometry clause of def-signed-idempotent, ||p_v-p_j||_1<=D:=2+4*delta for every row p_j, so t_j:=H-phi(p_j)=phi(p_v)-phi(p_j)<=D. Also phi<=0 on C and ||u||_inf<=1 imply phi(p_j)<=d_j:=dist_1(p_j,C); since v is a hidden top vertex of height H, d_j<=H for all rows, and by the definition of G_a, j notin G_a gives d_j<=a*tau. Therefore t_j>=H-d_j>=0 for all j and t_j>=H-a*tau for j notin G_a.
